notes: The only supplied page for this programme is a Parcoursup fiche. The tuition of 178 EUR/year is the French/EU rate shown there; the differentiated rate for extra-communautaire students (2,902 EUR/year for Licence) appears on the Campus France page and is not specific to this programme, so it is not stated as a fact. No intake deadline was found: the Parcoursup fiche does not state a day/month/year deadline for international applicants, and the Études en France page names no date.
